rationale.speed: Requested 20/25 km/h experimental ceilings; no demonstrated cruise or safety rating.
rationale.reverse: Forward-only first navigation profile; reverse converter remains an offline contract pending plant tests.
rationale.stop_resume: Explicit numerical diagnostic thresholds, not measured standstill accuracy or stopping capability.
rationale.command_timeout: Five nominal 20 Hz smoother periods; wall-clock instrumentation proposal, not a validated destination watchdog.
rationale.observation_and_clock: Wall-clock diagnostic deadlines; must be evaluated against observed load, never interpreted as physical braking proof.
